scope: Fixed non-even scalar stationary DPP centres and general mean/cosine/sine affine directions

completed_results.scope: One changing complex Hermitian edge at an arbitrary strict finite centre; not a multi-edge or rate theorem

repeated_verification: Independent B1 implementation; complete 36-Hessian phase replay; independent exact B1 rate audit and author-code replay. See coverage.md; repetitions are not new centres.
stop_reason: Two distinct phase mechanisms returned to the same full Fisher-versus-mixed-acceleration sign obstacle. The fixed B1 true-rate gap is negative, not a counterexample.
minimum_remaining_obligation: A new controlled mixed-edge/mean mechanism defeating the complete Fisher cost, followed by a fixed feasible three-symbol positive rate gate (L_minus+L_plus)/2-U_center>0, or a rigorous continuous-family argument.
restart_condition: Substantive new mechanism or explicit fixed candidate after coordinator reassessment; no unchanged larger scan.
delivery_validation: The final issue/PR receipt records local/server commit, equal public Git tree, clean checkouts and completed-job checks; commit IDs are external to avoid a self-referential checkpoint.
public_scope: No full-conjecture solution, continuous-family exclusion, formal verification or novelty priority claim.
